generated.description: A large wooden sailing ship modeled on the Dutch East India Company (VOC) vessel Prins Willem, built mostly from spruce logs, oak planks and white terracotta hull panels. It stands about 94 blocks high and 115 blocks long, with a fence-and-slab rigging look and a few coal and nether brick accents on the deck and stern. The source gives no interior details or block entities, so it reads as an exterior shell only.
